shared_elements: carved/incised stone surface with a defined decorated field
a band of repeated small motifs along an upper edge (scalloped/petal row in A, repeated vertical signs in B)
justification: A depicts a naturalistic standing human figure in profile holding a tall spear, with pleated robe, elaborate headdress and a bordering row of scallops, while B depicts a shaped standing stone bearing a curved panel filled with rows of abstract repeated signs and no figures at all. The only overlap is the very generic presence of a repeated small-motif band along an upper edge, which any carving tradition could produce independently.
